How we know

Mexico City's daily ride agenda (La Silla Rota) lists Chirimixquic's Bike at 6:15 pm from the Reloj de Tecómitl on Fri Sept 4, Sept 11 and Sept 25, 2026 (fetched Oct 1, 2026). Secondary source: the host's own channels were not found.

For visitors

Group size is capped at 25 in the city's filing. Rides head into the hills of Milpa Alta and out to the State of Mexico (Chalma on Sept 25), so lights are needed for the ride back. Not listed on Fri Sept 18; check before going.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:15 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace isn't posted. Ask the host before you go, or say you're new when you arrive.
Check
Check the links below the day of for cancellations and weather calls.

About the Chirimixquic's Bike, rodada del viernes group ride

Chirimixquic's Bike, rodada del viernes is a social group ride in Mexico City, Mexico. It rolls every Friday at 6:15 pm local time from Reloj de Tecómitl.

A Friday-evening group ride from the Tecómitl clock on the south-east edge of Mexico City. Destinations in September were Cerro San Miguel and the Feria del Elote in Santa Ana Tlacotenco, then the church at Chalma in the State of Mexico.
